code.description: Identifier of the exchange rate. The identifier consists of the source currency and the target currency separated by an underscore.

sourceCurrency.description: Source currency code. The currency symbol must consist of three capital letters and must be a valid ISO-4217 code (https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) defined in the system.

targetCurrency.description: Target currency code. The currency symbol must consist of three capital letters and must be a valid ISO-4217 code (https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) defined in the system.

rate.description:
Represents the exchange rate.

The value of the field is represented by a number where the cent part is separated by a dot. For example `1.09`. The cent part is not limited just to two digits. A rate with any precision can be returned. For example: `1.091934212`
